column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key referencing core_record(CoreRegistry).
An enum (EmploymentStatus_enum) for employment status (Self-employed, Employed, Unemployed, Retired).
A SMALLINT indicating length of employment in years (e.g., '5').
An enum (JobTitle_enum) labeling the job (Manager, Teacher, Doctor, Other, Engineer).
An enum (IndustrySector_enum) naming the sector (Education, Technology, Healthcare, Finance, Other).
A TEXT field storing the employer name (e.g., 'ABC Corp').
A DECIMAL(12,2) capturing annual income in currency units (e.g., '65000.00').
A DECIMAL(12,2) capturing monthly income (e.g., '5400.00').
An enum (IncomeVerification_enum) describing income verification status (Pending, Verified, Failed).
A REAL score of how stable the income is (e.g., '7.5').
A DECIMAL(12,2) indicating additional income (e.g., '500.00').
An enum (AdditionalIncomeSource_enum) for source of additional income (Investment, Rental, Part-time).
A DECIMAL(12,2) capturing total household income (e.g., '90000.00').
A SMALLINT rating how stable the employment is (e.g., '4').
An enum (Risk3_enum) indicating industry risk (Low, Medium, High).
An enum (Risk3_enum) indicating occupation risk (Low, Medium, High).
An enum (Risk3_enum) for income source risk (Low, Medium, High).
An enum (Risk3_enum) for geographic risk (Low, Medium, High).
An enum (Risk3_enum) capturing demographic risk (Low, Medium, High).
An enum (EducationLevel_enum) labeling education (Doctorate, High School, Master, Bachelor).
A DECIMAL(5,3) for debt-to-income ratio (e.g., '0.320').
